stage2_patch.explanation: Inserted `check_forum_password($forum['fid'])` in the `addsubscription` action for forum type, after the `canview`/`canviewthreads` permission check and before `add_subscribed_forum()`. This reuses the existing forum password guard from `inc/functions.php` (available via `global.php`) to block unauthorized subscriptions to password-protected forums. The guard denies access by rendering the `forumdisplay_password` template and exiting or redirecting for parent forums, so no sensitive subscription state change occurs without the password. Existing logged-in user check and all other business logic are preserved.
